title: QUIZ - 34
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate the cube root of a perfect cube
questions.question: Evaluate: \( \sqrt[3]{64} \)
questions.explanation: \( \sqrt[3]{64} \) = 4 because \(4^3 = 4 \times 4 \times 4 = 64\).
questions.hint: The cube root of a number is the value that, multiplied by itself three times, gives that number.

questions.learningObjective: Recognize the equivalence between radical notation and fractional exponent notation
questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to \( \sqrt{25} \)?
questions.explanation: A square root can be written as an exponent of 1/2: \(\sqrt{25} = 25^{1/2}\), both equal to 5.
questions.hint: A square root is equivalent to raising a number to the power of one-half.

questions.learningObjective: Recognize that the square root undoes squaring
questions.question: Since 4^2 = 16, what is \( \sqrt{16} \)?
questions.explanation: Squaring and taking the square root are inverse operations: since 4^2 = 16, it follows that \(\sqrt{16} = 4\).
questions.hint: Squaring and square-rooting undo each other.
